fields.label: Walk-in customer
fields.description: Set up automatically: the customer a walk-in who pays in this currency is billed to.

fields.label: Cash in this currency
fields.description: Set up automatically, with a cash account in this currency.

fields.label: Show the equivalent on local sales
Give change in this currency
fields.description: On: a sale in this currency gives its change in it, from its own cash drawer. Off: change comes back in the company currency, from the main drawer. An outlet whose POS Profile names its own Account for Change Amount keeps it (ERPNext uses it on every sale).

fields.label: Rate
fields.description: Fixed: the rate the shop sets. Automatic: updated once a day, when automatic rates are switched on in LumenPOS Settings.

fields.label: Margin below the published rate
fields.description: The till values this currency this much below the published rate, the way a shop taking it at a market rate does.

fields.label: Automatic rate status
fields.description: Set by the daily update: per company currency, the published rate, the rate used, when, and any error.
